definitions.gloss: unsatisfying; not enough; leaving something to be desired
definitions.explanation: The feeling that something is incomplete or insufficient, leaving one wanting more.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{量|りょう}が{物足|ものた}りない。
examples.english: The amount of food is not enough.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{説明|せつめい}は{物足|ものた}りなかった。
どこか{物足|ものた}りない{気|き}がする。
examples.english: I feel like something is missing.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{物|もの} (thing) + {足|た}りない (not sufficient) → something is lacking

FORMS:
・Adverbial: {物足|ものた}りなく
・Noun form: {物足|ものた}りなさ (the feeling of insufficiency)

CONJUGATION:
・Negative: {物足|ものた}りなくない (double negative - rarely used)
・Te-form: {物足|ものた}りなくて
・Past: {物足|ものた}りなかった

USAGE PATTERNS:
・Xが{物足|ものた}りない (X is unsatisfying)
・どこか{物足|ものた}りない (something feels lacking)
・{物足|ものた}りない{気|き}がする (to feel that something is lacking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{足|た}りない (not enough) - more direct, often about quantity
・{物足|ものた}りない - implies emotional/qualitative insufficiency
・{不満|ふまん} (dissatisfaction) - stronger discontent
